purpose: Make the transport/evidence path attributable before any future model execution.

gates.name: CGW_INSTANCE_BINDING
requirements: config host=127.0.0.1 and port=17841
health service/version/mode exact and idle
health.pid is a positive integer
exactly one LISTEN owner exists for 127.0.0.1:17841
listener PID == health.pid
launcher-supervisor.json exists and status=ready
supervisor daemonPid == health.pid
supervisor ownerPid process exists
daemon process exists and command line contains serve
launcher-browser.json exists and parses
launcher log contains runtime.daemon_started for the same daemonPid in current or rotated log

gates.name: CGW_LOCAL_ROUTE_CANARY
requirements: GET /v1/responses only; never POST
same bound listener returns the source-defined HTTP 426 local-route response
no browser turn, no model request, no MCP call

gates.name: CODEX_OUTBOUND_REQUEST_WITNESS
requirements: use exact qualified Codex 0.153.4 binary
use isolated temporary CODEX_HOME
point openai_base_url to a GWF loopback witness, not CGW
witness must reject before upstream/model forwarding
capture only bounded request metadata: method/path, model, request-body hash, tool count/names/types, thread/turn metadata presence
prove chatgpt-web/high is emitted to the configured loopback Responses endpoint
prove expected native mutation-capable tool surface is or is not advertised before any real model execution

gates.name: EVIDENCE_SINK_SOURCE_BINDING
requirements: freeze exact CGW source commit and critical source blobs
prove full mode => localToolsEnabled=true
prove broker.register precedes browser send in frozen source
prove browser-page-acquired capture precedes browser send in frozen source
prove launcher-owned daemon stdout/stderr feed launcher.jsonl
derive diagnostics root from the same CORE_HOME bound by RP-I1

activation_rule: Only RP-I1 + RP-I2 + RP-I3 + RP-I4 PASS may open a new governance review for a replacement scientific attempt. PASS does not itself authorize such an attempt.

evidence_policy.route_event_must_have_direct_source: Each route event must be directly observed at its boundary; do not manufacture codex_request/browser_submit/mcp_roundtrip events from missing logs.

unresolved_historical_choice: H-R2 dual observation-sink failure on correct instance
